title.en: An Act Authorizing the Director of Lands to Assign to Provincial Treasurers the Fees Collectible From Cadastral Surveys, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The Director of Lands, with the approval of the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources,
is hereby empowered to assign to provincial treasurers the fees collectible from cadastral surveys executed
under Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and fifty-nine, as amended, and under Act Numbered Thirty-three
hundred and twenty-seven, as amended, at a discount of from six to eight per centum. The provincial
treasurers may, with the approval of the provincial boards concerned and the Secretary of the Interior, pay the
Bureau of Lands out of any funds they may have in their possession which are not needed for immediate use,
based upon surplus provincial funds or trust fund not in excess of twenty per centum of the yearly average
balance in the last three years immediately preceding the year of the assignment.

In order to expedite the collection of cadastral costs, for which the provinces have made advance
payments, the provincial treasurers may appoint the necessary employees at a compensation to be approved by
the provincial board, and in cases of disagreement, the same shall be submitted to the Chief of the Executive
Bureau whose decision thereon shall be final. The salaries of such employees shall be chargeable against the
cadastral collections accruing to the provincial funds.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 5, 1930.
